privileged_info_for_vlm: The target altitude is 200.0 meters with a tolerance of ± 2.0 meters (198.0m - 202.0m). The motor must be an Estes C6 (specifically C6-5). The final files must be saved at /home/ga/Documents/rockets/tuned_altitude_rocket.ork and /home/ga/Documents/exports/ballast_tuning_report.txt.
